title: Baa Juice Blue Raspberry Bubblegum 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Nic Salt Blue Raspberry Bubblegum combines the tangy sweetness of Blue Raspberry with the nostalgic, sugary notes of classic Bubblegum. This playful and vibrant blend delivers a bold and satisfying vape, perfect for those who enjoy fruity flavours with a retro twist. As part of the Baa Juice Bar Salts collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid is crafted with a double-concentrated flavour profile, replicating the rich and intense taste of single-use disposable vape bars. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s designed for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) pod kits and starter devices, providing smooth throat hits and quick nicotine satisfaction. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Blue Raspberry Bubblegum is a versatile and economical choice for vapers seeking bold, flavour-packed blends.
